data.long_meaning: Avighna is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'avighna' meaning 'obstacle' and 'na' meaning 'remover'. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer the strength to overcome all obstacles and challenges. It is a name of great power and resilience, inspiring confidence and determination. The name Avighna carries the meaning “Obstacle remover” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avighna usually hope their child will grow to embody obstacle remover and live with faith, good character and purpose.
